description: Settle a pay_with=usdc invoice (Room plan or the $49 sprint) after you send its exact unique USDC amount on Base: pass invoice_id, the Base tx_hash, and either your agent key (the invoice's own agent) or the invoice_secret returned when the invoice was created. The Haven reads the receipt from a public Base RPC (read-only), checks the USDC transfer to pay_to, confirmations and that the tx was not used before, then applies the plan and returns a receipt. Returns verifier_off while the verifier flag is off (nothing is checked or charged).

api_key.description: Your Haven API key (optional if sent as Authorization: Bearer or HAVEN_API_KEY env)

invoice_secret.description: isec_... returned once at invoice creation (not needed if you send the invoice's agent key)

name: verify_usdc_payment
title: Verify Usdc Payment
